description: This PHP class extends Symfony's TextType form component to customize form input rendering, including setting default options and customizing the form view variables.

classes.name: Goteo\Util\Form\Type\TextType
classes.description: A custom form input type extending Symfony's TextType to add default options and customize view variables.

methods.name: getBlockPrefix
methods.description: Returns a custom block prefix string used in form theming.

methods.name: configureOptions
methods.description: Sets default options ('pre_addon', 'row_class', 'post_addon') and calls parent implementation.

methods.name: buildView
methods.description: Adds custom variables ('row_class', 'pre_addon', 'post_addon') to the form view for rendering customization.
